findings.title: parseBody after c.req.formData() re-serializes cached FormData and fails or corrupts
findings.why_it_matters: A handler that calls c.req.formData() (or any code path that caches formData first) and then c.req.parseBody() used to work because parseBody called the cached formData(). It now calls request.arrayBuffer(), and HonoRequest's #cachedBody rebuilds the buffer via new Response(cachedFormData).arrayBuffer(). That serializes as multipart with a fresh undici boundary, which is then parsed with the original request Content-Type. Multipart requests throw 'Failed to parse body as FormData.' and urlencoded requests return garbage keys such as '------formdata-undici-...\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name'.
findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, for a HonoRequest use request.formData() (which honors bodyCache.formData) and keep the mixed-case normalization by normalizing the Content-Type only when falling back to buffer parsing. For example, if request.bodyCache.formData exists, await it. Otherwise read arrayBuffer, call bufferToFormData, and cache the result. Alternatively, normalize the header on a cloned Request.
evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()
src/request.ts:228-235 -- when bodyCache has another key, #cachedBody returns (bodyCache[anyCachedKey]).then((body) => { ... return new Response(body)[key]() })

Scratch repro (Hono app, POST FormData foo=bar, handler: await c.req.formData(); await c.req.parseBody()): parseBody -> 'ERR Failed to parse body as FormData.'. Same handler with URLSearchParams body -> parseBody returns {'------formdata-undici-030118036602\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name': ...}. Base commit body.ts:125 used (request as Request).formData(), which returned the cached value.

residual_risks: parseFormData overwrites request.bodyCache.formData unconditionally with a cast Promise; a rejected parse is cached and re-thrown to later c.req.formData() callers.

Behavior change: parseBody now requires an exact media type match (no more startsWith), and non-Hono Request callers now read the body via arrayBuffer plus Response.formData, which differs slightly from Request.formData in some runtimes (not exercised).
testing_gaps: No test covers calling c.req.formData() (or a cached formData) before c.req.parseBody(); the old mock-based dot test was replaced with a real FormData, and no test exercises HonoRequest with a pre-populated bodyCache.formData.
